input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale:
Section 13 (p0078) provides an initial one-year term with automatic renewal for successive one-year (not multi-year) periods, and either party — including us as Client — may prevent renewal on just thirty (30) days' written notice. That notice window is well inside the preferred ≤30 days and the fallback ≤60 days, and the 12-month renewal term matches the preferred position; nothing approaches walk-away territory (no >90-day window, no multi-year auto-renewal). Two preferred-position sub-elements are absent and are noted rather than redlined: there is no Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal, and there is no express cap on renewal price increases (CPI/3%), although p0047 freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds an MFN rate protection in our favour. On its material terms the clause meets the preferred position, so we do not redline it.</rationale>
